test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

(Beside myself, the only English people) there were Keith and Doreen.

options.text: Besides I, the only English speaking people
Besides me, the only English people

solution: The correct answer is '4' i.e. Besides me, the only English people .
